For reorder list basic I will split, reverse, then weave.

```python
def reorder(head):
    if not head or not head.next: return
    slow, fast = head, head
    while fast.next and fast.next.next:
        slow = slow.next; fast = fast.next.next
    prev, cur = None, slow.next
    slow.next = None
    while cur:
        nxt = cur.next; cur.next = prev; prev = cur; cur = nxt
    a, b = head, prev
    while b:
        na, nb = a.next, b.next
        a.next = b; b.next = na
        a, b = na, nb
```
